consumer: The NPC door-dialogue gate's possession check, asking 'is the id_card on the player's body right now?'
scope: On-person inventory only (worn/wielded/carried), NOT the reachable/crafting inventory
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — tests type->item_id quantity against u.crafting_inventory(), which spans nearby reachable/surrounding items, not just what is carried on the body
divergence: The id_card lies on an adjacent tile or in a nearby accessible container (within crafting reach) while the player carries nothing: crafting_inventory().has_amount returns true, so the surface says 'complete', but the true on-person possession check is false — the gate opens though you are not carrying the keycard
